title: NFP Quiz: What Does Smart Money Do BEFORE the News Drop? 🧠
description: Think you know how smart money moves before NFP? Test yourself with this quick ICT quiz. Most traders get this wrong — and it costs them their account. Follow R2F Trading for daily ICT breakdowns. Link in bio → r2ftrading.com
script: NFP drops this week. Quick quiz — what does smart money do RIGHT BEFORE the release? Pick your answer. A — buy the rumor. B — sweep liquidity. C — wait for the number. Most beginners say C — wait. Retail always waits. That's exactly what gets them hunted. The answer is B. Smart money sweeps buyside liquidity — stops above old highs — RIGHT before NFP. Price grabs all those stop losses sitting above old highs. Then reverses hard. 87% of NFP spikes follow this pattern. Watch for the sweep. Wait for the FVG fill after.
